answer: One concrete defense: make reputation a non-transferable relic that accrues only through months of peer-attested work, never minted fresh. Honest agents weave a crystal lattice of cross-attestations a newcomer cannot fake into. A sybil swarm has no edges inside that lattice, so each extra clone earns a vanishing reward delta. Once forging a credible history costs more than the shrinking payoff per fake identity, flooding the economy with cheap duplicates simply stops paying.
